name: 风险（排查/评估/防控）措施

map.📖 查看「风险（排查/评估/防控）措施使用指南」: 📖 View the "Security Risk Assessment & Control Planner Guide"
map.📚 深度解析：风险（排查/评估/防控）措施: 📚 In-Depth: Security Risk Assessment & Control Planner
map.风险等级 = 可能性 × 影响程度（5×5风险矩阵）: Risk level = likelihood x impact (5x5 risk matrix)
map.可能性1-5：极少/不太可能/可能/较可能/几乎肯定: Likelihood 1-5: rare / unlikely / possible / likely / almost certain
map.影响程度1-5：微小/轻微/中等/重大/灾难性: Impact 1-5: negligible / minor / moderate / major / catastrophic
map.风险值1-25，1-4低风险/5-9中风险/10-15高风险/16-25极高风险: Risk value 1-25: 1-4 low / 5-9 medium / 10-15 high / 16-25 very high
map.园区/厂区季度排查：把已识别风险项按可能性与影响各打 1–5 分，得到风险值与分: Quarterly campus/plant inspection: score identified risk items 1-5 for likelihood and impact to obtain risk values and a graded action list.
map.大型活动前对人群拥挤、临时用电、恶劣天气等项打分，排出处置优先级。: Before a large event, score items such as crowd congestion, temporary power and severe weather to prioritise actions.
map.仓储与生产安全检查后，把整改项按风险值从高到低排序，作为限期整改依据。: After warehouse and production safety inspections, sort remediation items by risk value from high to low as the basis for deadline-driven fixes.
map.同分不同组合的处置差异: Different combinations with the same value
map.可能性 4×影响 4＝16 判为极高风险（立即停止/隔离风险源），而可能性 2×: Likelihood 4 x impact 4 = 16 is rated very high (stop immediately / isolate the source), while likelihood 2 x impact 5 = 10 is only high; both feel "fairly large" intuitively, but the former needs immediate action and the latter can be fixed within a deadline, so the two factors must be scored separately.
map.用排序定整改顺序: Using ranking to set remediation order
map.10 个风险项打分后按值降序，前三项为 20/15/12；资源有限时先处理这三项: After scoring 10 risk items and sorting by value, the top three are 20/15/12; with limited resources, handle these three first and keep items below 5 under routine monitoring to avoid spreading remediation effort too thin.
map.可能性和影响怎么打分？: How should likelihood and impact be scored?
map.可能性按本周期内发生的频次或概率分 1–5 档，影响按一旦发生的人员、财产与运营: Score likelihood in 1-5 bands by frequency or probability within the period, and impact in 1-5 bands by the personnel, property and operational consequences if it occurs; score the two separately then multiply, since a single overall score hides combination differences.
map.风险值相同的两项谁先处理？: Of two items with the same risk value, which comes first?
map.优先处理影响分更高的那项（后果更严重）。防控的最终目标是降低后果，而不只是压低发: Handle the one with the higher impact score first (the more severe consequence). The ultimate goal of control is to reduce consequences, not just lower the probability.
map.是 5×5 风险矩阵的常用四档切分：≥16 立即处置、10–15 限期整改、5–: They are the common four-band split of a 5x5 risk matrix: >=16 act immediately, 10-15 fix within a deadline, 5-9 step up monitoring, <5 routine management; organisations can shift the bands to their own risk appetite.
map.安全风险排查评估与防控工具，支持动态添加风险点，按5x5风险矩阵（可能性x影响）: A security risk assessment and control tool: dynamically add risk items, compute risk values on a 5x5 matrix (likelihood x impact), automatically grade them low / medium / high / very high, render a risk-matrix heatmap and give scenario-specific control measures.
map.风险等级自动判定（低/中/高/极高）: Automatic risk grading (low / medium / high / very high)
